transcript.text: Before we proceed, I need to share an important finding from our department's classroom pilot. The pilot found that the OpenMath Core package actually requires 90 minutes of mathematics intervention per week for our planned student grouping model — not the 60 minutes listed in the draft implementation plan. I recorded this in the department pilot binder, but I want to make sure everyone is aware of it now, since the binder hasn't been uploaded to the adoption folder yet.

transcript.text: Thank you, Dr. Morgan. I'd like to share my findings from the multilingual learner family review. We identified 22 enrolled eighth-grade students who need a Spanish-English mathematics glossary supplied with the core materials. I completed this review with the families, but the result is still in my consultation notes rather than the adoption form, so I want to make sure it's on the record now. This is something that should be addressed before final approval, as the draft implementation plan does not currently list any multilingual supplement.
